1.預測目的
目標是預測各YouBike站點的租借量／還車量，目的是為了提升車輛調度效率，降低人力成本，並從中理解時段與天氣變數對流量的影響。

2.預測資料(df_merged)
(1)時間序列：日期、時間
(2)站點資訊：站位數、借車量、還車量...
(2)天氣資訊：降雨量、溫度、風速...
(3)新增dummy variable：尖峰時段、假日、深夜、下雨、高溫、強風...

3.對應變數(y)造成影響的自變數(x)
(1)是否尖峰：8點, 9點, 17點, 18點
(2)是否高溫：>25℃
(3)是否強風：>3m/s
---
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(randomForest)
library(lubridate)

```

read
```{r}
df_weather <- read_csv("weather2024_3-5.csv")
df_stat_info<- read_csv("ntu_area_ubike_stations_sorted.csv")
df_stat_flow_m3<- read_csv("station_flow_202403_new.csv")
df_stat_flow_m4<- read_csv("station_flow_202404_new.csv")
df_stat_flow_m5<- read_csv("station_flow_202405_new.csv")

```

只抓前十個站 
```{r}

df_stat_flow_m3 <- df_stat_flow_m3[df_stat_flow_m3$station %in% unique(df_stat_flow_m3$station)[1:10], ]
unique(df_stat_flow_m3$station)

df_stat_flow_m4 <- df_stat_flow_m4[df_stat_flow_m4$station %in% unique(df_stat_flow_m4$station)[1:10], ]
unique(df_stat_flow_m4$station)

df_stat_flow_m5 <- df_stat_flow_m5[df_stat_flow_m5$station %in% unique(df_stat_flow_m5$station)[1:10], ]
unique(df_stat_flow_m5$station)

df_stat_info <- df_stat_info[df_stat_info$sna %in% unique(df_stat_info$sna)[1:10], ]

```

合併資料
```{r}

df_all <- bind_rows(df_stat_flow_m3, df_stat_flow_m4, df_stat_flow_m5) %>%
  arrange(station, date, hour)

glimpse(df_all)
unique(df_all$station)



# 假設兩邊的日期與時間欄位名稱如下：
# df_all$date   <->  df_weather$日期
# df_all$hour   <->  df_weather$觀測時間(hour)

df_merged <- df_all %>%
  left_join(df_weather, by = c("date" = "日期", "hour" = "觀測時間(hour)"))
df_merged$`Unnamed: 0` <- NULL

# Simple and quick
df_merged <- na.omit(df_merged)


```
新增三項時間特徵變數與淨借車
```{r}

df_merged <- df_merged %>%
  mutate(
    # 確保 date 為 Date 格式、hour 為整數
    date = as_date(date),
    hour = as.integer(hour),

    # ---- 尖峰時段旗標 ----
    peak_hour = as.integer(hour %in% c(8, 9, 17, 18)),


    # ---- 深夜時段 ----
    night = as.integer(hour %in% c(0:5, 23)),
    
    # ---- 淨借車量 ----
    net_borrow = borrow_count - return_count
  )


df_merged$`最大瞬間風風向(360degree)` <- NULL
df_merged$`風向(360degree)` <- NULL
df_merged$`露點溫度(℃)` <- NULL
df_merged$`海平面氣壓(hPa)` <- NULL 
df_merged$`降水量(mm)`[df_merged$`降水量(mm)` == "T"] <- 0





```

```{r}


library(dplyr)

df_merged <- df_merged %>%
  rename(
    station_pressure   = `測站氣壓(hPa)`,
    temperature        = `氣溫(℃)`,
    humidity           = `相對溼度(%)`,
    wind_speed         = `風速(m/s)`,
    max_wind_speed     = `最大瞬間風(m/s)`,
    rainfall           = `降水量(mm)`,
    rain_duration      = `降水時數(h)`,
    solar_radiation    = `全天空日射量(MJ/㎡)`,
    uv_index           = 紫外線指數
  )

```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 🚉 篩選單一站點
df_single <- df_merged %>%
  filter(station == "捷運公館站(2號出口)")

# 1️⃣ 長表
base <- df_single |>
  pivot_longer(c(borrow_count, net_borrow),
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(peak_hour = factor(peak_hour, c(0,1), c("off-peak","peak")))

# 2️⃣ 每面板各自的中心視窗（例：P10~P90）
rng <- base |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  summarise(lo = quantile(value, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            hi = quantile(value, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

base_zoom <- base |>
  inner_join(rng, by = "variable") |>
  filter(value >= lo, value <= hi)

# 3️⃣ 用全資料計算中位數
meds <- base |>
  group_by(variable, peak_hour) |>
  summarise(median_val = median(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 4️⃣ 繪圖：放大 + 中位數虛線 + 中位數標籤
ggplot(base_zoom, aes(x = value, fill = peak_hour)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.45, adjust = 1, position = "identity") +
  geom_vline(data = meds, aes(xintercept = median_val, color = peak_hour),
             linetype = "dotdash", linewidth = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = meds,
            aes(x = median_val, y = 0,
                label = paste0("median=", round(median_val, 1)),
                color = peak_hour),
            angle = 90, vjust = -0.6, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_x",
             labeller = as_labeller(c(
               borrow_count = "borrow_count",
               net_borrow = "net_borrow"
             ))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray70", "firebrick"), name = "peak_hour") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("gray40", "firebrick")) +
  labs(
    title = "捷運公館站(2號出口) — peak vs off-peak hours",
    x = NULL, y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)


```
##統計降水量、氣溫、風速分佈##
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

#各組先轉數字再統計各區間的數值有多少個
df_merged$rainfall[is.na(df_merged$rainfall)] <- 0 #NA值補0
df_merged$rainfall <- as.numeric(df_merged$rainfall)
ggplot(df_merged, aes(x = rainfall)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue")

df_merged$temperature <- as.numeric(df_merged$temperature)
ggplot(df_merged, aes(x = temperature)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue")

df_merged$wind_speed <- as.numeric(df_merged$wind_speed)
ggplot(df_merged, aes(x = wind_speed)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue")

summary(df_merged$rainfall)
summary(df_merged$temperature)
summary(df_merged$wind_speed)

```

##設定dummy variable + 畫密度圖##
```{r}

#依統計分佈圖分組設定dummy variable(約取Q3數值作為分界)
#雨量以0(mm)為分界，>0有雨，dummy variable = 1，<=0無雨，dummy variable = 0；溫度以25(℃))為分界，>25高溫，dummy variable = 1，<=25低溫，dummy variable = 0；風速以3(m/s)為分界，>3強風，dummy variable = 1，<=3弱風，dummy variable = 0。
df_merged <- df_merged %>%
  mutate(
    rain_any     = as.integer(rainfall > 0),   # 有下雨 = 1（無 = 0）
    temp_hot     = as.integer(temperature > 25),     # 熱天（>25℃） = 1
    wind_strong  = as.integer(wind_speed > 3)     # 風大（>3m/s） = 1
  )

df_merged %>%
  group_by(rain_any) %>%
  summarise(
    median_borrow = median(borrow_count),
    n = n() 
  )
df_merged %>%
  group_by(temp_hot) %>%
  summarise(
    median_borrow = median(borrow_count),
    n = n()
  )
df_merged %>%
  group_by(wind_strong) %>%
  summarise(
    median_borrow = median(borrow_count),
    n = n()
  )

# 計算各組的中位數
medr <- df_merged %>% #雨量中位數
  group_by(rain_any) %>%
  summarise(med = median(borrow_count, na.rm = TRUE))

medt <- df_merged %>% #溫度中位數
  group_by(temp_hot) %>%
  summarise(med = median(borrow_count, na.rm = TRUE))

medw <- df_merged %>% #風速中位數
  group_by(wind_strong) %>%
  summarise(med = median(borrow_count, na.rm = TRUE))

# 畫密度圖 + 中位數虛線
ggplot(df_merged, aes(x = borrow_count, fill = factor(rain_any))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(data = medr, aes(xintercept = med, color = factor(rain_any)),
             linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "borrow_count vs is_rain", fill = "is_rain") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 150, 10), limits = c(0, 50)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.1)) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(df_merged, aes(x = borrow_count, fill = factor(temp_hot))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(data = medt, aes(xintercept = med, color = factor(temp_hot)),
             linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "borrow_count vs is_temp_hot", fill = "is_temp_hot") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 150, 10), limits = c(0, 50)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.1)) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(df_merged, aes(x = borrow_count, fill = factor(wind_strong))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(data = medw, aes(xintercept = med, color = factor(wind_strong)),
             linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "borrow_count vs is_wind_strong", fill = "is_wind_strong") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 150, 10), limits = c(0, 50)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.1)) +
  theme_minimal()
```

library(dplyr)

# 2️⃣ 每面板各自的中心視窗（例：P10~P90）
rng <- base |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  summarise(lo = quantile(value, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            hi = quantile(value, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

base_zoom <- base |>
  inner_join(rng, by = "variable") |>
  filter(value >= lo, value <= hi)

# 3️⃣ 「用全資料」計算中位數（推薦）
meds <- base |>
  group_by(variable, weekend) |>
  summarise(median_val = median(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 4️⃣ 繪圖：放大 + 中位數虛線 + 中位數標籤
ggplot(base_zoom, aes(x = value, fill = weekend)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.45, adjust = 1, position = "identity") +
  geom_vline(data = meds, aes(xintercept = median_val, color = weekend),
             linetype = "dotdash", linewidth = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = meds,
            aes(x = median_val, y = 0,
                label = paste0("median=", round(median_val, 1)),
                color = weekend),
            angle = 90, vjust = -0.6, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_x",
             labeller = as_labeller(c(
               borrow_count = "borrow_count",
               net_borrow = "net_borrow"
             ))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray70", "firebrick"), name = "weekend") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("gray40", "firebrick")) +
  labs(
    title = "捷運公館站(2號出口) — weekend vs weekday",
    x = NULL, y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)

rf model

```{r}




library(data.table)
library(ranger)
library(caret)     # 這裡只拿來算 R^2 / RMSE（也可不用）

set.seed(42)

#--- 0) 準備 ----
dt <- as.data.table(df_merged)   # 你的資料
targets      <- c("borrow_count", "net_borrow")
exclude_cols <- c("station","date","hour", targets)
features     <- setdiff(names(dt), exclude_cols)

stations <- unique(dt$station)   # 10 個站

# 放結果
model_list  <- list()
metrics_dt  <- list()

#--- 1) 逐站 × 逐目標 ----
for (st in stations) {
  d <- dt[station == st][order(date, hour)]
  n <- nrow(d); if (n < 50) next
  n_tr <- floor(0.8 * n)

  tr <- d[1:n_tr]
  te <- d[(n_tr+1):n]

  for (y in targets) {
    fml <- as.formula(paste(y, "~", paste(features, collapse = " + ")))

    rf <- ranger(
      formula     = fml,
      data        = tr,
      num.trees   = 1000,           # 你 example 的設定；要更穩可拉到 500-1000
      importance  = "impurity",
      num.threads = 0,             # 0=用滿 CPU
      seed        = 42
    )

    # 預測 + 指標
    pred <- predict(rf, te)$predictions
    y_te <- te[[y]]
    rmse <- sqrt(mean((pred - y_te)^2))
    mae  <- mean(abs(pred - y_te))
    r2   <- caret::postResample(pred = pred, obs = y_te)[["Rsquared"]]

    key <- paste(st, y, sep = " :: ")
    model_list[[key]] <- rf

    # 存檔（將站名中的特殊字元改成底線）
    fn <- paste0("rf_", y, "_", gsub("[^\\w]+", "_", st), ".rds")
    saveRDS(rf, fn)

    metrics_dt[[key]] <- data.table(
      station = st, target = y, n_train = n_tr, n_test = n - n_tr,
      RMSE = rmse, MAE = mae, R2 = r2
    )
  }
}

metrics <- rbindlist(metrics_dt)
print(metrics[])



```
